title: Test easy and tricky cases
summary: A prompt needs more than one successful trial. A small test set should include normal inputs, missing information and confusing cases.
introduction: A prompt needs more than one successful trial. A small test set should include normal inputs, missing information and confusing cases. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain test easy and tricky cases
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A prompt needs more than one successful trial. A small test set should include normal inputs, missing information and confusing cases.

blocks.code:
Task: extract a meeting room
Case 1: Room 4 is stated -> Room 4
Case 2: no room stated -> Not provided
Case 3: cancelled old room and a new room -> choose the current one with evidence
blocks.title: Test easy and tricky cases

blocks.text: The cases test different failure modes. The expected result is written before evaluating the response.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a case where two current notices conflict.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not silently remove failed test cases to make a prompt look better.
For more detail later, use this [Prompt Engineering further reading](https://www.promptingguide.ai/introduction).
